what_this_is: Callaway and Sant'Anna's sample, step by step, for the headline set at 2% and for every cohort utility as built (the labelled companion). Provisional: the design stands as of 2026-11-18 and the plan is not frozen. Quantities only (load, sales, customers, ownership, the usable flag); no price, revenue or bill is read. The estimator itself has not been run on the study's data; diff-diff 4.0.0 is installed only in the gizmo folder's isolated .venv and has been run there on invented inputs only.
comparison_sample_difference_headline_se: This run's comparison sample differs from the headline's. On the headline set at 2%, 680 of the 1,670 never-treated units are in no cohort's host region at that cohort's reference year (g-3), and 605 of them are in none of the four host regions (West, ERCOT, SPP, Southeast) at any of the five reference years (counted 2026-11-19 from this module's sample() on quantity files; docs/gate1/callaway-santanna-regions-without-host-2026-11-19.md). The headline's matched comparison utilities come from each host's own region in its reference year. These units stay in this run's sample by Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19 (D-111) and inform the gas-share slope, region entering as a covariate. A difference between this run's estimate and the headline estimate cannot be attributed solely to the estimator.
ruling: the owner's ruling of 2026-11-19 on Callaway and Sant'Anna (pipeline/analysis/callaway_santanna.py)

steps_in_order.load: Comparison utilities, rule 2: under 0.5% in every year as built (power_simulation.design takes the largest share over all years), no crypto-mining load of 2% or more, and a unit with load but no 2009-2011 sales cannot be shown clean. Every host, early host and late host fails it, so none is a never-treated unit.
steps_in_order.set_aside: Comparison utilities, rule 2: not set aside on either side (power_simulation.set_aside, as design.split applies it to the set's comparison utilities): every admissible history and no anchoring.
steps_in_order.uncertainty_load_unknown: Comparison utilities, rule 2 (D-96 item 2): a unit reached by a site with no load history is eligible only if the enumeration decided it (UnknownLoad.gate, as design.build_with_rules applies it).
steps_in_order.customer_floor: Unit: at least 2,000 residential customers. A unit that meets the customer floor in no year has no usable year; in every other unit the floor enters year by year through the usable flag.
steps_in_order.price_hold: Comparison utilities, rule 5: not in price_hold.csv.
steps_in_order.main_design_window_inputs: The agent's reading: the never-treated units are the comparison-eligible units of the main design, whose windows hold only units whose state has a 2008-2010 gas share and degree days (power_simulation.build_windows); Alaska and Hawaii are outside every run with degree-day controls.
steps_in_order.own_utility: Comparison utilities, rule 3: a unit sharing an EIA id with any included host (D-54 ruling 2).
steps_in_order.ownership_any_included_host: Comparison utilities, rule 3, under the owner's ruling of 2026-11-19: a unit ownership.ineligible_for excludes for ANY included host, over THAT host's window (g-6 to g+3), the union over hosts. Same ultimate parent in a window year (documented and assumed spell ends both entering, each labelled), or investor-owned with no ownership row covering some year of the window of an investor-owned host (rule 2.2 read year by year, D-107: unknown ownership is not evidence of independence). A unit with a row for part of that window is named apart with its uncovered years.

unknown_ownership_years: Rule 2.2 read year by year, the main design's own rule (Joe, 2026-11-19, D-107): an investor-owned unit with a year of an investor-owned included host's window that no ownership row covers is excluded by ownership.ineligible_for, because unknown ownership must not become evidence of independence. Those with a row for part of the window are named apart with their uncovered years. The one difference from the main design is the union: here a unit barred for one host is out for every cohort, where the main design bars it only for the hosts whose windows it does not cover.
parent_identity_mark: The ownership table carries no column marking a row's parent identity as supported. A row is in the table only with a source and a quote (ownership.load), and the existing code counts every row, assumed at both ends or not, as a row; this sample does the same.

rows_for_part_of_a_window.rule: Rule 2.2 read year by year, the main design's own rule (Joe, 2026-11-19, D-107): an investor-owned unit with a year of an investor-owned included host's window that no ownership row covers is excluded by ownership.ineligible_for, because unknown ownership must not become evidence of independence. Those with a row for part of the window are named apart with their uncovered years. The one difference from the main design is the union: here a unit barred for one host is out for every cohort, where the main design bars it only for the hosts whose windows it does not cover.

sample_difference_from_the_main_design.comparison_sample_difference_disclosed: This run's comparison sample differs from the headline's. On the headline set at 2%, 680 of the 1,670 never-treated units are in no cohort's host region at that cohort's reference year (g-3), and 605 of them are in none of the four host regions (West, ERCOT, SPP, Southeast) at any of the five reference years (counted 2026-11-19 from this module's sample() on quantity files; docs/gate1/callaway-santanna-regions-without-host-2026-11-19.md). The headline's matched comparison utilities come from each host's own region in its reference year. These units stay in this run's sample by Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19 (D-111) and inform the gas-share slope, region entering as a covariate. A difference between this run's estimate and the headline estimate cannot be attributed solely to the estimator.

rows_for_part_of_a_window.rule: Rule 2.2 read year by year, the main design's own rule (Joe, 2026-11-19, D-107): an investor-owned unit with a year of an investor-owned included host's window that no ownership row covers is excluded by ownership.ineligible_for, because unknown ownership must not become evidence of independence. Those with a row for part of the window are named apart with their uncovered years. The one difference from the main design is the union: here a unit barred for one host is out for every cohort, where the main design bars it only for the hosts whose windows it does not cover.

sample_difference_from_the_main_design.comparison_sample_difference_disclosed: This run's comparison sample differs from the headline's. Never-treated units in no host's region at a cohort's reference year (g-3) stay in this run's sample by Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19 (D-111), region entering as a covariate. The count on file (680 of 1,670 never-treated units, 605 on the stricter count) is for the headline set at 2% and was not made for this set. A difference between this run's estimate and the headline estimate cannot be attributed solely to the estimator.

sample_difference_from_the_main_design.unknown_ownership_years_difference: Both this run and the main design bar an investor-owned unit with no ownership row in a year of an investor-owned host's window (rule 2.2 read year by year, Joe, 2026-11-19, D-107). The main design bars it for that host only; this run takes the union over the included hosts, so the unit is out for every cohort. The units listed beside this are matched or pooled in the main design for a host whose window their rows cover.
stated_differences_from_the_main_estimat: no ten-closest-in-size restriction: neither package does nearest-neighbour matching
the comparison group is every never-treated unit, not each host's ten matched comparison utilities

market region (dummy columns, read at the base period g-3) and the state's 2008-2010 gas share enter as covariates in an outcome regression, not as region-by-year effects within matched sets and gas share by calendar year
no heating or cooling degree days
never-treated units are not required to be usable over a whole window; each group-time effect uses units usable at g-3 and t
ownership exclusions are the union over every included host, each over that host's window, not host by host

an investor-owned unit with a year of unknown ownership in any investor-owned included host's window is excluded for every cohort; the main design applies the same rule (rule 2.2 read year by year, D-107) host by host

never-treated units in a region with no host in its reference year stay in the sample and inform the gas-share slope (the main design's rule 1 is per host; here region is a covariate); kept by Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19 (D-111) and counted in comparison_sample_difference_disclosed. A difference between this run's estimate and the headline estimate cannot be attributed solely to the estimator.

the support rule (D-54 ruling 2) is not applied: it is defined on each host's ten matches, which this run does not have; hosts the main design drops under it stay here and are named in hosts_here_not_in_the_main_design_estimate

the range is secondary and uncalibrated: the module's t-based construction (the headline plus or minus the t critical value on the number of states less one, times the standard deviation of the bootstrap draws of the headline), its standard error from the package's multiplier bootstrap; not calibrated by the inference comparison
